summary: Practise Python, pandas and PySpark workflows for larger datasets, validation and clear reporting. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Big data analytics with Python helps analysts prepare and validate datasets that exceed routine spreadsheet workflows. For data analysts, reporting specialists and junior data engineers, it covers inspecting CSV, JSON and Parquet files, checking schemas and data quality, and choosing memory-aware pandas or distributed PySpark processing. You’ll also practise validating aggregations and documenting reproducible notebook findings, with foundation-level coverage of Spark SQL and execution plans.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who handle, prepare or report on datasets that challenge routine spreadsheet workflows. It suits people ready to use beginner-level Python code to inspect data and produce repeatable analyses.
modules: Python Workload Framing and File Intake
Spark SQL Joins and Skew Diagnostics
prerequisites: No prior Python programming is required. Basic file handling and comfort with spreadsheets are helpful; you will write and run beginner-level Python code during the exercises, so coding is required for completion. Bring a laptop with Python, JupyterLab, pandas, NumPy, PySpark and a compatible local Apache Spark setup installed before training.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
